note.question: How do performance prediction and robot assignment at a robotic fulfillment center interact?
note.overview: E-commerce giants scale up their order-picking operations by adopting robotic fulfillment centers (RFCs). In RFCs, automated guided vehicles transport movable shelf racks to pickers’ workstations, instead of having human pickers travel to pick items. Unfortunately, this apparent relief for pickers turns out to be a curse: Pickers become the bottleneck in the order-picking process.
